title: Speeding Up Ethereum Client Development with LLMs
description:
"Ship faster" is what the community and funders ask of core devs. The usual answer is to leverage AI; but how much more efficient can we become?

I want data. I am looking at where the time really goes in client development. Nobody measures the gap between an idea and a merged, tested change. I will compare what I find against a year of LLM agents on Lighthouse. And identify opportunities to ship faster without sacrificing safety.
